work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: The act ends Archbishop Aggiuri's administration of Melkite Aleppo and commits the election of a new archbishop to Patriarch Ignatius. Issuer evidence GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF14078; own dating clause LF14140–14143 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die vigesimaquarta decembris millesi- mo octigentesimo trigesimo primo, pontificatus Nostri anno primo.. Own provenance note LF14125 excluded as edition furniture. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
